Using \(\sin^2 x+\cos^2 x=1\):
\[
(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2+(\sin\theta\cos\theta)^2=1
\]
\[
1+2\sin\theta\cos\theta+\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta=1
\]
\[
\sin\theta\cos\theta(\sin\theta\cos\theta+2)=0
\]
Since \(|\sin\theta\cos\theta|\le \frac12\), we must have \(\sin\theta\cos\theta=0\). Thus \(\cos x=0\).

Then
\[
\cos 2x=2\cos^2 x-1=-1
\]
so
\[
\cos^5 2x=(-1)^5=-1.
\]

\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
